page.content:
U.S. president who moved from Lend-Lease to full belligerence.

How Franklin D. Roosevelt connects

  • Faction: Allies — Roosevelt led the United States into and through the Alliance.
  • Event: Pearl Harbor — Pearl Harbor brought Roosevelt's United States fully into the war.
  • Work: Atlantic Charter — Roosevelt and Churchill issued the Atlantic Charter in 1941.

What is Franklin D. Roosevelt?

Franklin D. Roosevelt armed Britain and the USSR before Pearl Harbor, then led the United States through the coalition conferences until his death in April 1945, weeks before VE Day.

Key threads lead to Allies, Pearl Harbor and Atlantic Charter.
